_notes.postgres_sqlite: The Digital Garage MCP server is the preferred typed database boundary. Add a generic Postgres/SQLite MCP only if you want direct schema access; keep it read-only for AI clients.
_notes.docker: Docker Desktop MCP Toolkit/Gateway is recommended as the production way to aggregate containerized MCP servers and manage secrets.
_notes.google_drive: Use a Google Drive MCP/connector with write scope restricted to DIGITAL GARAGE — OPENAI BUILD; treat pre-existing /FOST material as read-only.
_notes.home_assistant: Add your chosen Home Assistant MCP server only after restricting its tools. Do not expose vehicle CAN/ECU write paths through Home Assistant.
_notes.rest_api: The garage FastAPI service is the stable external REST boundary; add a generic REST/OpenAPI MCP client if desired.
_notes.terminal: Prefer Claude Code's controlled terminal or a sandboxed terminal MCP scoped to the garage workspace. Never expose unrestricted vehicle-write scripts by default.
_notes.windows: The filesystem example uses Docker bind mounts and Windows-style host paths. Replace YOU and C:/dev/focus-st with your actual paths.
